video_title: EMERGENCY REACTION: Memphis Trades Ja Morant To Portland

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant traded to Portland for Chris Murray and Jeremy Grant
quotes.excerpt: Ja Morant gets traded at long last to the Portland Trail Blazers for Chris Murray and Jeremy Grant.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Ja Morant gets traded at long last to the Portland Trail Blazers for Chris Murray, first-round pick from three years ago, and Jeremy Grant, veteran wing that the Blazers have.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Well, can I just give a howdy partners to start? Nice to see you as well.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Grizzlies fan base will not be happy with Ja Morant trade
quotes.excerpt: This is obviously not going to be a popular trade for the Grizzlies fan base.
quotes.quote: This is obviously not going to be a popular trade for the Grizzlies fan base. Memphis, to the very end, love Ja Morant, but it's not like the destination kind of came as a surprise, but everybody knew that the Grizzlies had been desperately trying to trade Ja Morant for months, going back to before the deadline and even quietly before that. They were basically able to wash their hands of the situation without giving up anything of future value.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Portland's backcourt of Ja Morant and Damian Lillard is fascinating
quotes.excerpt: The fascinating part of this trade to me is on the other end, is the Portland end.
quotes.quote: The fascinating part of this trade to me is on the other end, is the Portland end. You've got Ja Morant, Damian Lillard, Scoot Henderson, Drew Eubanks, Shaden Sharp. The obvious question is, what do the Trail Blazers have cooking? We know they've been shopping around for stars. We know they've been in discussions about Jaylen Brown. I've got to think that the guys who aren't going to be in the starting lineup are all very much available in other trade discussions at this point.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson is due for a contract extension with Portland
quotes.excerpt: It's time to do a contract extension with Scoot Henderson if you're still inclined.
quotes.quote: It's time to do a contract extension with Scoot Henderson if you're still inclined. Scoot had a good second half of the season last year after he came back from that nasty hamstring injury that pretty much derailed his whole first half of the year. He hasn't been good efficient-wise, he just hasn't shot the ball real well, but his efficiency was a little bit better, got to the line a little bit higher rate, was able to generate some assists. Scoot actually had a little bit of momentum and there was a question about whether they would invest in him.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard and Ja Morant starting in the same backcourt
quotes.excerpt: What do you think about the idea of Damian Lillard and Ja Morant starting in the same backcourt?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: What do you think about the idea of Damian Lillard and Ja Morant starting in the same backcourt? Because I think that's where we're headed here. Dame has got a no-trade clause, so he will not be traded.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: It will be extremely entertaining if both those guys are on the floor, which they hopefully are. Dame unfortunately has obvious durability concerns coming off of the Achilles, and Ja staying on the floor has been a big problem.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's availability and shooting efficiency are major concerns
quotes.excerpt: Ja's only played 79 games over the last three seasons. That's an issue.
quotes.quote: Ja's only played 79 games over the last three seasons. That's an issue. His scoring average has dropped four straight seasons. His three-point percentage over the last four years is under 30%. His athleticism because of the leg injuries that he's had has been better. You are definitely buying low on him. This could work out for the Blazers for a number of different reasons. Ja could be reinvigorated, the floor space that's going to be created with Lillard a little bit, he should be able to work one-on-one.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Memphis received seven first-round picks in the recent trades
quotes.excerpt: They got seven first-round picks, a swap, Jeremy Grant, Walter Clayton Jr. came in that deal.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: They got seven first-round picks, a swap, Jeremy Grant, Walter Clayton Jr. came in that deal from the Jazz. So if you look at everything, they got seven first-round picks, a swap, Jeremy Grant, Walter Clayton Jr. How do you feel about that?

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: I meant you forgot Taylor Hendricks, if you, you know. It's right, Taylor Hendricks who is a lottery pick from Utah. George Niang, the minivan.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Boozer was a key part of the Memphis trade haul
quotes.excerpt: They got bad enough to get Cam Boozer who was the third overall pick.
quotes.quote: They got bad enough to get Cam Boozer who was the third overall pick. That's absolutely part of this of this math. And look, is it disappointing if you're a Memphis Grizzlies fan and four years ago you were so optimistic and the Grizzlies were kind of this young, new, fresh-faced, cocky darlings of the league and you ended up with a playoff series victory to show for it?

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Grizzlies are in a rebuilding phase after trading core players
quotes.excerpt: They've got Cam Boozer, you've got Cedric Coward, you hope you have Zach Edey.
quotes.quote: You've got Cam Boozer, you've got Cedric Coward, you hope you have Zach Edey. We'll see about his health situation, but they've got a clear direction moving forward. And they are, they kind of, what happened was, they weren't good enough, so they decided to get a head start on a rebuild.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Grizzlies have too many players on their current roster
quotes.excerpt: They've got more guys now than you're allowed to have on the roster.
quotes.quote: There's more moves to be made by the Grizzlies. They might just end up having to eat some veteran salaries. They've got more guys now than you're allowed to have on the roster once the final cuts are made at the end of training camp or at the end of the preseason rather.
